```{r}
viability_clean <- viability %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_replace_all(`SAMPLE ID`, "-", "_"),
    id = str_trim(id),

    pair  = str_extract(id, "\\d+_\\d+"),
    month = str_extract(id, "[A-Z]{3}")
  ) 


# -------------------------
# CLEAN RAREQMRA
# -------------------------
rareqmra_clean <- rareqmra %>%
  mutate(
    Date = str_replace_all(Date, "-", "_"),
    Date = str_trim(Date),

    pair  = str_extract(Date, "\\d+_\\d+"),
    month = str_extract(Date, regex("[A-Za-z]{3}", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) 


viability_clean <- viability_clean %>%
  mutate(month = toupper(month))

rareqmra_clean <- rareqmra_clean %>%
  mutate(month = toupper(month))

# -------------------------
# MERGE
# -------------------------
merged <- viability_clean %>%
  inner_join(
    rareqmra_clean,
    by = c("pair", "month")
  )

merged$`Total cell counts` <- as.numeric(merged$`Total cell counts`)
merged$HPC <- as.numeric(merged$HPC)
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    ViableCells = ifelse(
      is.na(`Total cell counts`) | `Total cell counts` == 0,
      NA,
      (HPC / `Total cell counts`) * Reads
    )
  )
```

Constants
```{r}
# Constants for dose calculations
Efreq = 365 #day/year
Eduration = 1 #year
Avgtime = 25550 #day
QLflow = 5.0 * 10^-3 #m^3 / min
Qgflow = 5.0*10^-2 #m^3 / min
BodW = 70 #mg
AT = 25550
AE = 100 #%
CF = 1.67*10^-4 #Conversion factor for cm/hr to m/min
# Mass transfer coefficients (KolA) (m^3/min)
mtchclbr2 <- 4.6*10^-3
mtchcl2br <- 5.9*10^-3
mtchbr3 <- 3.7*10^-3
mtchcl3 <- 7.4*10^-3
KolAvg <- (mtchclbr2 +mtchcl2br + mtchbr3 + mtchcl3)/4
# Chemical Specific dermal permeability constant (cm/hr)
pcchclbr2 <- 2.98*10^-3
pcchcl2br <- 4.02*10^-3
pcchbr3 <- 2.35*10^-3
pcchcl3 <- 7.4*10^-3
PCavg <- (pcchclbr2 + pcchbr3 + pcchcl3 + pcchcl2br)/4
# Henry's Constant values for each DBP @ 298.15K and ideal gas, with 40 degree water
HCFM <- 0.15
HBFM <- 0.022
HBDCM <- 0.087
HDBCM <- 0.032
Henryavg <- (HCFM + HBFM + HBDCM + HDBCM)/4
```

#Monte Carlo Conditions for Exposure
Conditions are generated from standard distributions from the EPA. 

```{r}
# Monte-Carlo
conditions <- function(samp, seedchem = NULL){ 
  if (!is.null(seedchem)) {
    set.seed(seedchem)
  } else {
    warning("No seed provided!", call. = FALSE)
    seedchem <- sample.int(10000, 1)
    set.seed(seedchem)
    message("Random seed = ", seedchem, "\n")
  }

  # Create arrays of different variables based on known distributions
  parameters <- data.frame(
    breath   = runif(samp, min = 0.013, max = 0.017),
    time     = runif(samp, min = 5, max = 25),
    enrich   = rtri(samp, min = 100, max = 10000, mode = 1000),
    volume   = runif(samp, min = 2, max = 18),
    ingestion = runif(samp, min = 1e-3, max = 3e-3),
    pctpathogenma = runif(samp, min = 0.4, max = 0.6),
    pctpathogenleg = runif(samp, min = 0.005, max = 0.01),
    pctpathogenclos = runif(samp, min = 0.005, max = 0.01)
  )

  ## Monte Carlo droplet dispersion (cvd)
  cvd_storage <- numeric(samp)

  for (s in seq_len(samp)) {
    cvd <- 0
    for (i in 1:10) {
      if (i == 1) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 17.5, 0.3) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.23, 0.25))
      } else if (i == 2) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 17.5, 0.17) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.4, 0.53))
      } else if (i == 3) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 19.4, 0.35) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.36, 0.62))
      } else if (i == 4) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 19.4, 0.35) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.29, 0.61))
      } else if (i == 5) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 19.4, 0.35) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.19, 0.52))
      } else if (i == 6) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 19.4, 0.35) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.10, 0.4))
      } else if (i == 7) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 20.0, 0.31) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.06, 0.29))
      } else if (i == 8) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 20.0, 0.31) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.03, 0.19))
      } else if (i == 9) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 20.0, 0.31) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.01, 0.12))
      } else if (i == 10) {
        cvd <- cvd + (rlnorm(1, 17.5, 0.3) * ((pi/6)*((i*10^-6)^3)) * runif(1, 0.01, 0.06))
      }
    }
    cvd_storage[s] <- cvd
  }

  # Add cvd into the final dataset
  parameters$cvd <- cvd_storage

  return(parameters)
}

conds <- conditions(10000, 123)
```


Calculations start here:

Exposure Models
``` {r}
# Dose calculation function 
calculate_airconc <- function(concentration, condition) { 
  Vs <- condition$volume 
  Cw <- concentration 
  t <- condition$time 
  N = (KolAvg)/ QLflow 
  a = (QLflow *Cw *(1-exp(-N)))/Vs 
  b = (((QLflow/Henryavg) *(1-exp(-N)))+Qgflow)/Vs 
  Cst = (1-exp(-b * t))* (a/b) 
  Cair <- (Cst)/2 
  return(Cair) }


calculate_dose <- function(chemconc, bioconc, mc, airconcentration,
                           chemname, bioname,
                           sampleid, sampling_date, sample_type) {

  # --- Concentrations ---
  Cwbio  <- bioconc
  Cwchem <- chemconc

  # --- Exposure parameters ---
  SurfArea     <- mc$SA
  IR           <- mc$ingestion
  Exposuretime <- mc$time
  breath       <- mc$breath
  enrich       <- mc$enrich
  cvd          <- mc$cvd

  # --- Chemical dose ---
  InhaledChem <- (airconcentration * Exposuretime * Efreq * Eduration) / AT
  OralChem    <- (Cwchem * IR * Efreq * Eduration) / (BodW * AT)

  # --- Biological dose ---
  InhaledBio <- Cwbio * breath * Exposuretime * enrich * cvd

  # --- RETURN ONE ROW ---
  tibble::tibble(
    `SAMPLE ID`    = sampleid,
    SamplingDate   = sampling_date,
    SampleType     = sample_type,
    Chemical       = chemname,
    Pathogen       = bioname,
    InhaledChem    = InhaledChem,
    OralChem       = OralChem,
    InhaledBio     = InhaledBio,
    SurfArea = SurfArea,
    InhalationRate = IR,
    ExposureTime  = Exposuretime,
    Breath = breath,
    enrich = enrich,
    cvd = cvd
  )
}
```

```{r}
dosefunc <- function(data, conditions) {

  results_list <- vector("list", nrow(data))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {

    chemconc      <- data$Concentration[i]
    bioconc       <- data$Reads[i]
    chem_name     <- data$Compound[i]
    bio_name      <- data$Genus[i]
    sample_id     <- data$`SAMPLE ID`[i]
    sampling_date <- data$`Sampling Date`[i]
    sample_type   <- data$`SAMPLE TYPE`[i]

    air_concs <- calculate_airconc(chemconc, conditions)

    results_list[[i]] <- calculate_dose(
      chemconc,
      bioconc,
      conditions,
      air_concs,
      chem_name,
      bio_name,
      sample_id,
      sampling_date,
      sample_type
    )
  }

  bind_rows(results_list)
}

## Run
dose_results <- dosefunc(dose_input, conds)
```

```{r}
## Exponential distribution annual risk
doseresponseexp <- function(k, d){
  infdaily1 <- 1 - exp(-k*d)
  AnnInf <- 1 - (1 - infdaily1)^365
  return(AnnInf)
}

## Beta-Poisson Distribution annual risk
doseresponsebp <- function(a, n50, d){
  infdaily2 <- 1 - ((1 + d*((2^(1/a)-1)/n50))^-a)
  AnnInf <- 1 - (1 - infdaily2)^365
  return(AnnInf)
}

## Apply QMRA models to dose vector
conctoprobbacteria <- function(dosentoxdata){
  # Preallocate result vector
  results <- numeric(nrow(dosentoxdata))
  
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(dosentoxdata))) {
    dose <- dosentoxdata$InhaledBio[j]
    model <- dosentoxdata$ModelType[j]
    
    if (is.na(dosentoxdata$ModelType[j])) {
      results[j] <- NA
    } else if (dosentoxdata$ModelType[j] == "bp") {
      a <- dosentoxdata$a[j]
      N50 <- dosentoxdata$N50[j]
      results[j] <- doseresponsebp(a, N50, dose)
    } else if (dosentoxdata$ModelType[j] == "exp") {
      k <- dosentoxdata$k[j]
      results[j] <- doseresponseexp(k, dose)
    } else {
      results[j] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # Return as a dataframe with same number of rows
  dosentoxdata$AnnualRisk <- results
  return(dosentoxdata)
}
```

```{r}
# Load disease data
disease_data <- read_csv("finaldiseasedata.csv")

# Initialize disease_params list
disease_params <- list()
setnum <- 10000

for (i in 1:nrow(disease_data)) {
  disease_name <- make.names(disease_data[[i, 1]])

  # Sample duration
  duration <- if (!is.na(disease_data$durlow[i])) {
    if (grepl("normal", tolower(disease_data$durtype[i]))) {
      rnorm(setnum, mean = disease_data$durlow[i], sd = disease_data$dursd[i])
    } else {
      runif(setnum, min = disease_data$durlow[i], max = disease_data$durhigh[i])
    }
  } else { NA }

  # Sample severity
  severity <- if (!is.na(disease_data$dwlow[i])) {
    if (grepl("normal", tolower(disease_data$dwtype[i]))) {
      rnorm(setnum, mean = disease_data$dwlow[i], sd = disease_data$dwsd[i])
    } else {
      runif(setnum, min = disease_data$dwlow[i], max = disease_data$dwup[i])
    }
  } else { NA }

  # Build parameter list
  disease_params[[disease_name]] <- list(
    lostlife = disease_data$`Reduction_in_Life_Expectancy`[i],
    mort = disease_data$`Mortality_Rate`[i],
    duration = duration,
    severity = severity
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Wrapper function to calculate DALYs for all diseases
# Simplified Monte Carlo DALY calculation for one disease

DALYcalc <- function(probabilities, popservicearea, disease_params) {
  # Check for valid inputs
  if (is.null(disease_params$duration) || is.null(disease_params$severity)) {
    warning("Missing duration or severity in disease_params.")
    return(rep(NA, length(probabilities)))
  }

  if (length(probabilities) == 1) {
    probabilities <- rep(probabilities, length(disease_params$duration))
  }

  # Ensure all vectors are the same length
  n <- length(probabilities)
  if (length(disease_params$duration) != n || length(disease_params$severity) != n) {
    stop("Length mismatch between probabilities, duration, and severity.")
  }

  YLL <- probabilities * disease_params$lostlife * popservicearea * disease_params$mort
  prevalence <- probabilities * popservicearea * disease_params$duration
  YLD <- prevalence * disease_params$severity

  DALY_samples <- YLL + YLD
  return(DALY_samples)
}

```


```{r}

set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
popservicearea <- 10000
daly_results_bio <- numeric(nrow(probs))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(probs))) {
  disease <- probs$Pathogen[i]
  prob <- probs$AnnualRisk[i]
  params <- disease_params[[disease]]

  if (is.null(params)) {
    warning(paste("No parameters found for disease:", disease))
    next
  }

  # Randomly sample one value from duration and severity
  duration <- sample(params$duration, 1)
  severity <- sample(params$severity, 1)

  YLL <- prob * params$lostlife * popservicearea * params$mort
  prevalence <- prob * popservicearea * duration
  YLD <- prevalence * severity

  daly_results_bio[i] <- YLL + YLD
}

# Add to your data frame
probs$DALY <- daly_results_bio
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Setup: Use only first sample
# ===============================

n_conditions <- nrow(conds)  # should be 10000

# Take ONLY the first sample (first 10,000 rows)
pathogen_1 <- probs[10001:20000, ]

cat("Using first sample only\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(pathogen_1), "\n")


# ===============================
# Compute correlations (no expansion needed)
# ===============================

results <- sapply(names(conds), function(col) {
  cor(conds[[col]],
      pathogen_1$DALY,
      use = "complete.obs")
})

# Convert to data frame
results_df <- data.frame(
  condition = names(results),
  correlation = as.numeric(results)
)

# Sort by absolute importance
results_df <- results_df[order(abs(results_df$correlation), decreasing = TRUE), ]

print(results_df)

```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Setup: Use only first sample
# ===============================

n_conditions <- nrow(conds)  # should be 10000

# Take ONLY the first sample (first 10,000 rows)
chemset_first <- chemset[1:n_conditions, ]

# Sanity check
if (nrow(chemset_first) != n_conditions) {
  stop("First sample size does not match conditions")
}

cat("Using first sample only\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(chemset_first), "\n")


# ===============================
# Compute correlations (no expansion needed)
# ===============================

results <- sapply(names(conds), function(col) {
  cor(conds[[col]],
      chemset_first$DALYinh,
      use = "complete.obs")
})

# Convert to data frame
results_df <- data.frame(
  condition = names(results),
  correlation = as.numeric(results)
)

# Sort by absolute importance
results_df <- results_df[order(abs(results_df$correlation), decreasing = TRUE), ]

print(results_df)

```


```{r}
bsp_clean <- by_sample_pathogen %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_replace_all(`SAMPLE ID`, "-", "_"),
    id = str_trim(id),

    pair  = str_extract(id, "\\d+_\\d+"),
    month = str_extract(id, "[A-Z]{3}")
  ) 
finalinitial <- left_join(bsp_clean, rareqmra_clean, by= c('pair', 'month'))

fininitialcor <- cor(finalinitial$sample_mean, finalinitial$Reads)
fininitialcor
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(sample_mean)) %>%
```
